title: JeecgBoot: AI Skills Meet Low-Code — 46,000 Stars for China's AI-Native Development Platform
summary: JeecgBoot is China's most popular AI-powered low-code platform with 46,000+ GitHub stars. It combines traditional low-code generation with AI Skills that can generate entire systems from natural language descriptions — one sentence to draw workflows, design forms, and scaffold complete applications. With built-in AI chat, knowledge bases, MCP plugin support, and compatibility with mainstream Chinese and Western LLMs, it represents the convergence of AI agents and enterprise application development in China.
extractedSignals: AI Skills are being embedded directly into China's most popular low-code platforms, enabling natural-language-driven application generation — this represents a fundamentally different path to AI-assisted development than Western coding agents.

With 46,000 stars, JeecgBoot is one of China's most popular developer tools. Its addition of AI Skills marks the moment when AI agent capabilities move from experimental coding assistants into production development platforms used by thousands of enterprises. The combination of low-code scaffolding and AI-driven generation creates a development paradigm that doesn't exist in the Western market at this scale.
